reviews.notes: Research audit requested; reference was never actually watched; looked like an infographic.
lessons: Never claim to have watched a reference
Choose references whose techniques Remotion can reproduce

reviews.notes: Music and SFX too loud; competing with the narration.
lessons: SFX at least 20 dB below the voice, ducked

reviews.notes: Confusing: is it saying everyone pays $700 and won't invest? Wants every video clear and understandable for anybody.
lessons: Every video must be understandable by anybody, from narration alone and from pictures alone
Say the comparison word (instead / or / two people) and show alternatives side by side, labelled
Never merge two alternatives into one object
Label every symbol; state the takeaway in words on screen

reviews.notes: Add a good CTA on every video and a good hook at the beginning.
lessons: Every video opens with a spoken hook (<= 10 words) and an on-screen hook stamp readable on frame 0
Every video ends with a spoken CTA ('... and follow for more') and the on-screen CTA card (FOLLOW STACK WITH GIO + one episode-specific action)
Automated: a missing CTA is a QC FAIL
